overview.lead: Hunters are ranged damage dealers with a pet. Blizzard's deep dive says damage is their only role, the pet can tank in solo and small-group play, and Hunters have the longest range of any class.

points.text: Human Hunters are new in Forever; Alliance Hunters can be Human, Dwarf, Night Elf or Skyborne. Racials changed late: Dwarf Artisan's Precision is +1% hit, Human Ruthless +1% crit and Skyborne Wind-Blessed +2% haste (26 Oct).
Big kit changes: Aimed Shot is baseline at level 20, traps work in combat, Auto Shot needs a brief stand-still, and Trueshot Aura now buffs the whole raid.

101.summary: What every Hunter should know before choosing a spec.

overview.lead: Beast Mastery puts your pet at the centre: more pet damage, crit and speed, then Intimidation and Bestial Wrath (50% more pet damage for 18 seconds) deeper in the tree.

points.text: Summon Hawk is new: hawks attack your target for 18 seconds, up to 2 at once, and the ability shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
Guides agree it is the smoothest leveling spec, because your pet holds aggro with Growl and downtime stays low.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Endurance Training now raises your pet's armor as well as its health, which helps it hold mobs.
Pets earn 25% of the experience you get from mobs (no rested or quest XP) and stop at your level, per Warcraft Tavern.
Spirit Bond regenerates health for you and your pet, and Improved Revive Pet makes reviving faster and cheaper.
Tame Beast no longer works on beasts above your level (24 Sep).
Send the pet in first and let Growl build threat before you open fire.
Keep Hunter's Mark and Serpent Sting on the target and Auto Shot running; stand still briefly so it fires.
Use Summon Hawk on cooldown; Unleashed Fury and Ferocity boost hawks as well as your pet.
Fire Aimed Shot or Multi-Shot when ready; they share a cooldown.
Save Bestial Wrath and Rapid Fire for burst.
Keep your pet happy: happiness still scales its damage (125%, 100% or 75%).
Intimidation's stunning hit also gets 100% more crit chance in the snapshot.
You can own 3 pets, 1 active and 2 stabled. Each family has one unique ability, such as Bear Swipe hitting 3 targets or Wolf Furious Howl raising party melee Attack Power.
Pets now benefit from Expertise and take the higher of your melee or ranged crit (16 Oct).

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Intimidation stuns for 3 seconds on your pet's next hit, and Bestial Wrath makes the pet unstoppable for 18 seconds unless it is killed.

Pet tools were trimmed on 16 Oct: Crocolisk Dismember now cuts healing by 25%, Bat Sonic Blast slows casting by 30% on a 60-second cooldown, and Bird of Prey Mine! disarms for 3 seconds on a 90-second cooldown.
Warcraft Tavern suggests Dwarf or Human for Alliance PvP Hunters and notes that Night Elf Shadowmeld is fun in PvP.
Against Rogue: Sap no longer breaks a Rogue's Stealth, and Distract now warns you when a Rogue is near. Improved Mend Pet can cleanse a poison from your pet as it heals.
Against Warrior: Spearing Strike dismounts you, and Improved Berserker Rage can clear your slows. Keep the pet on them and use traps, which now work in combat.

overview.lead: Marksmanship is the pure ranged spec. Its capstone, Sniper Shot, is a long-range shot that also extends the range of your next 3 shots by 10 yards.

points.text: Lone Wolf adds 20% damage with all attacks while you have no pet out, and since 24 Sep skipping it costs nothing, so you choose pet or no pet.
Careful Aim turns part of your Intellect into Attack Power, and Trueshot Aura, now in row 4, raises the Ranged Attack Power of raid members within 45 yards.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Guides call Marksmanship viable but less forgiving than Beast Mastery for leveling.
Warcraft Tavern does not recommend Lone Wolf while leveling, so keep your pet out to tank.
talentsforever data lists Aimed Shot at a 2-second cast (Classic: 3) on a 6-second cooldown shared with Multi-Shot.
The Legacy perk Talented can start your talent points earlier. Guides disagree on how much, but the total stays 51.
Open with Hunter's Mark and Serpent Sting; a target that dies with your Serpent Sting on it grants Rapid Killing.
Fire Aimed Shot or Multi-Shot on cooldown (they share it), with Arcane Shot in between.
Use Sniper Shot when you can stand still for its 4-second cast, then make use of the extra range on your next 3 shots.
Keep Auto Shot running: it needs about half a second of standing still, but Aimed Shot and Sniper Shot no longer stop it.
Use Rapid Fire for burst; Rapid Killing shortens its cooldown.
Hawk Eye adds weapon range (2 yards at rank 1), stretching what is already the longest range of any class.
Efficiency trims mana costs, and Rapid Recuperation lets part of your mana regeneration continue while casting after Serpent Sting.
talentsforever data says Volley has no cooldown in Forever (Classic: 1 minute).
Mortal Shots requires Careful Aim at 5/5 in the snapshot, so plan both together.

omitted.reason: The spec overview above covers this.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Marksmanship brings Scatter Shot, a 4-second disorient that breaks on damage, and Improved Concussive Shot's chance to stun.
Auto Shot needs a brief stand-still since 16 Oct, so make space with traps and slows before you shoot.
Wyvern Sting is gone, and Scorpid Sting now lowers the target's hit chance by 2%.

overview.lead: Survival is rebuilt around melee and traps: Savage Strikes and Predator's Edge boost your melee crits, and Expose Prey and Lacerating Strikes revolve around Mongoose Bite.

points.text: Expose Prey gives your attacks against your Hunter's Mark target a chance to enable Mongoose Bite, and Lacerating Strikes makes Mongoose Bite add a bleed.
Warcraft Tavern calls Survival competitive in all PvE, and it keeps the defensive tools Hunters lean on in PvP.

101.summary: Leveling, the core rotation and the habits that matter first.

steps.text: Guides call Survival viable but less forgiving than Beast Mastery for leveling.
talentsforever data lists a new trainer bleed, Lacerate, at level 30.
Survivalist adds health (2% at rank 1), and Deterrence raises your dodge and parry by 25% for 10 seconds when a pull goes wrong.
Put Hunter's Mark on your target so Expose Prey can enable Mongoose Bite.
Use Mongoose Bite whenever it lights up; with Lacerating Strikes it also applies a bleed.
Keep Aspect of the Beast up in melee, since it now grants melee Attack Power.
Lay traps in combat (30-second cooldown). Strider Kick hits in melee and gives you 30% extra speed for 3 seconds, handy for sticking to a moving target.
Use Rapid Fire in melee too: talentsforever data says it also grants 40% melee attack speed.
Entrapment roots targets when your traps trigger, but Blizzard's 8 Oct notes added diminishing returns and limited it to Frost Trap's first hit.
Surefooted's hit now applies to all your attacks (1% at rank 1), and it shortens slows on you.
Predator's Edge also adds off-hand damage when you dual-wield (10% at rank 1).
Lightning Reflexes gives 10% Agility at max rank (Classic: 15%).

omitted.reason: The spec overview above covers this.

201.summary: Stat priorities, raid duties, consumables and PvP.

steps.text: Warcraft Tavern says Survival keeps the defensive PvP tools. In the snapshot those include Deterrence, Counterattack, Improved Wing Clip and Entrapment.
Traps now work in combat on a 30-second cooldown, Strider Kick adds a burst of speed, and Survivalist's Discipline shortens trap and Deterrence cooldowns.
Wyvern Sting was removed, so your control comes from traps, Counterattack's root and, if you take it, Scatter Shot from Marksmanship.
Against Warrior: Improved Berserker Rage can clear your slows and Spearing Strike dismounts you, so lean on Frost Trap, Counterattack's root and Deterrence.
